draft.subject: A hand with your first Willow Media project
draft.body:
Hi Dara,

Quick check-in now that your Willow Media workspace has been open a week. In Wrenfield, projects are the main organizing unit and tasks live inside them, so creating one real project is usually the step that makes everything else fall into place. The in-app onboarding flow walks through creating a first project, and when you're ready, a teammate can be invited from Account Settings -> Members at any time.

Would a short call this week help? I'm happy to walk through your first project with you and answer anything that's unclear.

Best,
Chidi
